_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'redcliff' (The Redcliff Frontier). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

commander_hild.name: Commander Hild Barrowman
commander_hild.greeting: Redcliff holds. Barely. Ask again tomorrow.

farmer_wat.name: Wat of Cinder Farm
farmer_wat.greeting: They burned the barn twice. I've stopped building barns. I've started building grudges.

quartermaster_pike.name: Quartermaster Pike
quartermaster_pike.greeting: Arrows, bandages, and coffins. Two of those sell well.

scout_orla.name: Scout Tamsin
scout_orla.greeting: Shh. Smugglers. And worse than smugglers. Cultists. Who smuggle.

quests.name: Flags over Redcliff
quests.offer: The warden says you can fight. Good. Warband raiders and their pet fire-imps are burning the frontier farms. Burn back.
quests.done: The farms will rebuild. The raiders came from Blackthorn Scar. That's where this ends.

quests.name: Cinder Farm
quests.offer: Hyenas came in after the fire and now they think the farm's theirs. It's mine. Mostly ash, but mine.
quests.done: Thank you. I'll name a barn after you. When I build one.

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.offer: Bandages to the fort. The road's lively. Don't drop them; they're the clean ones.

steps.text: Bring the bandages to Commander Hild

quests.done: Clean bandages! Somebody hug the quartermaster. Not me.

quests.name: Cellar Cultists
quests.offer: There's a cellar under the burned farm where cultists meet. Sky cultists, they call themselves. Mostly they shout at clouds.
quests.done: Fewer shouting people. The clouds thank you.

quests.name: The Frontier Keep
quests.offer: The raiders hold an old keep up the cliffs. Levels on levels of them. Take it apart floor by floor.
quests.done: The cliffs are ours again. Somebody fetch the flag.

quests.name: Wanted: The Red One
quests.offer: There's a beast on the frontier the raiders themselves are afraid of. That's either good news or very bad news.
